items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-11-18
items.q: Harry Faglitude on a banjo... I was playing tenor... Harry was a very good band to play with us.

ctx.x: Yeah. And Harry would be playing some banjo. And sometimes he'd get in a break and a tiger, and Harry would feel like he had fun, he wouldn't make the break. He'd let it go, ploka ploka ploka, you know. Let that dude make it. Harry was a very good band to play with us.
Sorry we didn't bring that picture here tonight. Yeah. But do you remember who else was in the band? Well yeah.
